# This is Suricata version 8.0.8 RELEASE, run by make-header-verdicts.py; do not edit by hand.
# 'rule SID RULE', or 'refused SID RULE' when Suricata does not load it,
# then 'packet N HEX SIDS': the IP bytes of each packet and the sids
# that alerted on it, '-' for none. # NAME before each packet says what it is.
rule 4000 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"syn only"; flags:S;)
rule 4001 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"syn ack"; flags:SA;)
rule 4002 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"syn and more"; flags:S+;)
rule 4003 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"syn or fin"; flags:*SF;)
rule 4004 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"not ack"; flags:!A;)
rule 4005 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"not syn ack"; flags:!SA;)
rule 4006 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"no flag"; flags:0;)
rule 4007 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"syn ignoring ecn"; flags:S,CE;)
rule 4008 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"ack ignoring push"; flags:A,P;)
rule 4009 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"fin push urg"; flags:FPU;)
rule 4010 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"cwr and more"; tcp.flags:C+;)
rule 4011 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"reset"; flags:R;)
rule 4012 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"seq"; seq:12345;)
rule 4013 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"ack number"; ack:777;)
rule 4014 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"window"; window:1024;)
rule 4015 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"window not"; window:!65535;)
rule 4016 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"mss"; tcp.mss:1460;)
rule 4017 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"mss below"; tcp.mss:<1000;)
rule 4018 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"wscale"; tcp.wscale:7;)
rule 4019 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"tcp header"; tcp.hdr; content:"|02 04 05 b4|";)
rule 4020 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"tcp header offset"; tcp.hdr; content:"|30 39|"; offset:6; depth:2;)
rule 4021 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"ttl"; ttl:3;)

rule 4023 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"ip id"; id:4242;)
rule 4024 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"tos"; tos:16;)
rule 4025 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"tos not"; tos:!0;)
rule 4026 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"proto udp"; ip_proto:17;)
rule 4027 alert ip any any -> any any (msg:"proto by name"; ip_proto:ICMP;)
